phase_1.name: final-leg-isolation
phase_1.convergence_rule: At least 90% success on 50 fixed curriculum validation episodes at two consecutive checkpoints.

phase_2.reason: The frozen Phase 1 convergence prerequisite was not met.

gate_3.reason: No eligible full-episode checkpoint exists because Phase 2 was correctly withheld.

interpretation.finding: Final-leg isolation plus discounted potential shaping did not produce reliable terminal completion under the bounded curriculum. Success improved from 0% to a transient 10%, then ended at 8%, far below convergence.
interpretation.shaped_return_note: Shaped return is training telemetry and is not comparable with the unchanged C3 base-return threshold.
interpretation.diagnostic_implication: The third revision did not validate the diagnosed remedy. Further changes require a new diagnostic round rather than another reward or curriculum tweak.

decision.required_next_action: Stop and perform a new diagnostic review before proposing any further Surveyor contract or training change.
